description: An issue was discovered in Lynxspring JENEsys BAS Bridge versions 1.1.8 and older. A user with read-only access can send commands to the software and the application will accept those commands. This would allow an attacker with read-only access to make changes within the application.

product.name: Lynxspring JENEsys BAS Bridge 1.1.8 and older
